anti_activators: task card already exists and scope is defined
user wants an engineering spec or API design — use specify or decompose
reviewing or critiquing an existing prd without producing a new one — use adversary
invariants: PRD contains no technical implementation details
All 7 quality criteria checked before presenting draft
Success metrics must be measurable with specific numeric targets
Scope section must list what is OUT as well as IN
User stories follow As a / I want / so that format
